meta.name: Color Field
meta.description: A full-canvas plasma field. Low/mid/high bands steer separate sine terms, brightness is gated by energy so silence falls to a calm dark wash, and feedback trails smear the motion. Shift the palette and pick a base mood.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in

color.h: settings.hueShift + if(settings.palette == 2, 0, 140 * sin(x * settings.scale + phase + 2 * low) * cos(y * settings.scale - phase + 2 * high) + 80 * warmth + if(settings.palette == 1, 40, 0))
color.s: if(settings.palette == 2, 0, 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(x * y * settings.scale + phase * 1.3 + 3 * mid))
color.v: smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy) * (0.25 + 0.75 * abs(sin(x * settings.scale + phase + low * 4) * cos(y * settings.scale - phase * 0.7 + high * 4))) + (1 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy)) * (settings.calmColor_r + settings.calmColor_g + settings.calmColor_b) * 0.2
